$schema.lineOffset: number (in px) - distance between two routes going to the same squares
$schema.circleRouteRadius: number (in px) - radius of the circle used to draw curved routes
$schema.circleCenterOffset: number (in px) - distance added from the end of a square
$schema.maxSquareFactor: array of 2 numbers (percent of diagram width and height) - maximum siz28 of a4 square
$schema.minSquareFactor: array of 2 numbers (percent of diagram width and height) - minimum size of a square
$schema.maxSizeThreshold: number - maximum number of squares before using the minimum size
$schema.minSizeThreshold: number - minimum number of squares before using the maximum size
$schema.squareFontSize: number (percent of square size) - size of the font used for the text in the squares
